name: com.vdopia.ads.lw.mraid.LVDOBrowserActivity
description: Vdopia’s ad SDK opens an in-app browser when an ad link is tapped or an interactive ad opens a web page. It loads the destination and provides back, forward, refresh, share, and close controls.
disableEffect: The Vdopia in-app ad browser and its navigation and sharing controls will not be available.
